hypotheses.construction_plan: Instantiate the two-parameter template T(x, y) by substituting the ordered argument pair (x, y) with (i, j) for the first member and with (j, i) for the second member.
required_assumptions: T is a two-argument function symbol
i and j are distinct atomic symbols
proof_obligations: T(i, j) - specialize(T(x, y), {x: i, y: j}) = 0
T(j, i) - specialize(T(x, y), {x: j, y: i}) = 0
hypotheses.rationale: Both members are applications of the same two-argument function T, differing only in the order of the supplied arguments. A parameterized template T(x, y) captures that shared structure without asserting equality or commutativity of the two members.
